messages:
Priya (CS): Heads-up — Helios renewal next week. They asked for a concise scorecard showing account health, projected renewal risk, and how uptime/latency credits would be applied if thresholds are missed. Can we produce a one-pager + sample calc?
Diego (Account Exec): +1. I'll be on the renewal call. Customer wants to see: current uptime, P95 latency by route, and an example credit line item. Also want an explanation of rounding/aggregation for monthly credits.
Mark (Ops): We have the raw credit rules in the ops playbook but the numbers are from before dedicated routing. I'll pull last 30 days for Helios and run the aggregator.
Eva (Eng): Important: the P95 targets differ by model/route — chat = 150ms, embeddings = 250ms. That affects which credit tier triggers. Also note heavy-model fallbacks can spike latency briefly.
Priya (CS): Good catch. The one-pager should list per-route SLOs, recent measured P95, uptime %, and sample credit calc with line: "If uptime < 99.9% and >= 99.0% => X% credit" — but phrase it in words for non-technical stakeholders.
Mark (Ops): I'll run this query and attach CSV: `SELECT route, service, p95_latency_ms AS p95, uptime_percent AS uptime FROM redwood.metrics WHERE customer='helios' AND window='30d'` — then map to credit tiers. Expect CSV in ~60m.
cs-ops-bot: Incident 1763012345: 2026-02-28 17:12 UTC — degraded throughput in us-west. Auto-credit applied: $2,802.33. Ticket: #INC-3421.
Diego (Account Exec): We'll need an example that shows both a latency breach and an uptime shortfall so the customer understands how credits stack (or don't). Priya, can you include a tiny FAQ on stacking and rounding?
Priya (CS): Yes — I’ll add a 3-bullet FAQ: 1) How we calculate monthly windows, 2) Whether multiple breaches in a month sum or cap, 3) Rounding rules. Also will prepare a tiny enablement checklist for Helios SREs: traces to check, quick mitigations, and how to request expedited review.
Eva (Eng): Suggest adding a note about routing/fallbacks: if we automatically downgrade to a smaller model due to capacity, that can lower latency but may affect quality — include guidance for customers deciding between strict latency vs strict quality SLAs.
Mark (Ops): CSV + draft credit calc uploaded: https://files.redwood/helios/credit-calc-1766129999.csv — numbers look like: chat P95=168ms, embeddings P95=210ms, uptime=99.94% — projection shows a potential $0 credit this month, but two past incidents would have triggered $2802.33 in Feb (matches bot).
Priya (CS): Great. I'll stitch the scorecard: one-page PDF + appendix with the exported CSV and the sample calculation table. Can we review internally tomorrow EOD?
Diego (Account Exec): Works for me. I'll also prepare 2 slides for renewal: 1) health summary, 2) how credits would be calculated if needed.
Mark (Ops): If anyone wants the raw query or wants me to change window to 90d, ping me.
Priya (CS): No objections. I'll draft the one-pager and FAQ, post draft here for comments. Aim: finalize by Tue so Diego can rehearse for Wed renewal. :thumbsup:
